approvalDecisionId.description: PROJECTION FIELD. The id of the decidesk Decision (decisionType contract / contract-renewal) raised for this contract's approval/sign-off, resolved via the ADR-019 integration registry. Empty until the contract is submitted for approval. stackiq never authors an approval decision locally; it raises it in decidesk and stores the returned id here for outcome reconciliation.
approvalDecisionId.title: Approval decision id

approvalState.description: PROJECTION of the decidesk outcome for the approval/renewal decision — distinct from the catalog lifecycle field `status`. `none` = no decision raised; `pending` = a decidesk Decision is open; `approved` = decidesk reported an adopting outcome (this is the ONLY thing that drives the `In onderhandeling -> Actief` transition on `status`); `rejected` = decidesk rejected/withdrew (status stays `In onderhandeling`). stackiq NEVER sets `status = Actief` on its own authority — it is always a projection of an `approved` decidesk outcome. The date-driven `Actief -> Verlopen` expiry transition is catalog-local and is NOT a decision delegated to decidesk.
approvalState.title: Approval state
